caption: The drawing consists of a grid of fifteen squares arranged in five rows and three columns against a beige background. Each square contains a distinct pattern or motif. The patterns are primarily floral, abstract, or geometric, utilizing various shades such as mint green, beige, black, red, pink, blue, and brown. The top row has, from left to right: a mint-green background with small red and purple feather-like shapes, a white background with repeating brown cloud-like outlines, and a white background with intersecting jagged red and black lines. The second row includes a beige background covered in sparse colorful floral motifs in red, blue, and brown, a cream background with thin reddish-brown branch patterns, and a white background with alternating parallel horizontal lines in blue and red patterns. The third row shows a pinkish background with small flowers and branches in red, blue, and black, a white background densely filled with clustered black marks resembling tiny branches, and a white background with repetitive horizontal lines of pink wave patterns. The fourth row consists of a square bisected horizontally, the upper half with a white background and colorful flowers, and the lower half with densely packed black and gray floral motifs, a white background with blue and black wavy lines and small circular elements, and a white background with sparse black horizontal lines and small marks. The bottom row displays a black background with white floral shapes, a beige background with interconnected blue and brown squiggly lines, and a white background with a few scattered small black flowers and marks.
title: 15 Printed Cottons
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
